pageSubtitle: Technology, Innovation and Human Balance for a Sustainable Future
introText: We see sustainability not only as an environmental responsibility, but as a management approach grounded in people, technology and ethics. With our expertise in industrial software and automation, we build solutions that increase efficiency, optimize resource use and accelerate digital transformation across end-to-end operations.
journeyDesc: Since our founding, we have acted in line with the principles of reliability, sustainability, people-centeredness, transparency and social benefit; viewing technology as a tool that shapes not only today's industry but the industry of the future.
year2000Desc: alongside our first exports, we expanded globally and integrated energy savings, process optimization and environmental awareness into every project.
yearsBullet3: Remote energy and OEE monitoring systems,
yearsConclusion: have raised awareness across many areas.
year2022Desc: the initiative we launched as 'SISKON Grove' quickly grew into a '5,000-tree Siskon Forest', becoming a symbol of our commitment to nature.
year2023Desc: we activated our Integrated Management System, bringing quality, environment, information security and occupational health & safety processes under a single framework.
year2024Desc: we expanded our sustainability approach—now a core component of our strategic goals—to an international level by incorporating Siskon Romania into our organization.
todayBullet4: Employee engagement and social responsibility projects
todayConclusion: form the building blocks of our sustainable growth journey.
summaryText: With solutions developed in collaboration with the industry's leading global technology brands, we aim to build low-energy, data-driven manufacturing systems aligned with both digital and green transformation goals.
futureSubtitle: The Center of Digital and Green Transformation
futureTagline: Our goal is to create value not only for today's needs, but also for the responsible industry of the future.
futureDesc: Our products, supported by AI, IIoT and data integration technologies, help our customers reduce energy consumption, lower carbon emissions and manage production processes more efficiently.
ctaDescription: Let's plan digital and green transformation solutions tailored to your operations.
